name: karnataka-districts
source: Census 2011 district and sub-district boundaries (datta07/INDIAN-SHAPEFILES, derived from Survey of India / Census). Vijayanagara (2021) is the union of the 2011 taluks Hosapete, Kudligi, Hagaribommanahalli, Hoovina Hadagali and Harapanahalli; Kampli taluk, carved from Hosapete in 2018 and retained by Ballari, cannot be separated at this resolution and is drawn inside Vijayanagara.
